test_title: SSC CHSL Tier-1 2024: Official Paper (Held On: 10 Jul, 2024 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
Select the option that will improve the underlined part of the given sentence. In case no improvement is needed, select No improvement required.

Although uncountable files stack up on the tables of government officials, they prefer doing their work __at a more leisure pace.__
solution:
The correct answer is **Option 2**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The primary issue in the sentence is the use of the term **"more leisure pace,"** which is incorrect.
 
• The correct term is **"more leisurely pace," **where "leisurely" is the appropriate adjective form.
 
• The revised phrase** "at a more leisurely pace" **ensures grammatical correctness and clarity.

Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 2**.

 

**Correct Sentence:** *"Although uncountable files stack up on the tables of government officials, they prefer doing their work at a **more leisurely pace.**"*

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 1: "at a more leisurely paced" **– Incorrect because "paced" should not be used here.
 
• **Option 3: "at a more leisure paced" **– Incorrect because "leisure" is a noun and should not be used as an adjective.
 
• **Option 4: "No improvement needed" **– Incorrect because the original sentence contains an error.
